turns.text: How records are linked to ABHA address in PHR application?

must_contain: In the app the patient searches for the hospital, the hospital answers with the visits it holds, the patient picks the visits to attach, and types in a one time password the hospital sends to the mobile number it has on file
It is three exchanges in order: discover, init, confirm
A linked care context is not a record in hand; reading it is a consent flow
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, case 10: 'Why is AI focusing on uploading records, when I am not asking or mentioning it again?' Verdict group: wrong shape for the question. The rejected answer opened with 'not by uploading a file into the PHR app', a tangent carried over from earlier turns; any mention of uploading fails this case.
